title: The mountain of Hira to colour
subject: Islamic Studies
unit: Summer 1: Eeman: angels, books and Qadr
source: Seeded from islamic-studies/y1 lesson 17 (Pupil PDF worksheet: the mountain of Hira to colour)
intro: Lesson 17: Allah's books and the first revelation. To understand that Allah sent books to His messengers and that the Qur'an is the last book, sent to Prophet Muhammad ﷺ

questions.q: Which book came to Prophet Muhammad ﷺ?
questions.model: Teacher points to the table: Muhammad ﷺ, then follows the row across: the Qur'an. 'The Qur'an came to Muhammad ﷺ.'

questions.q: What was the first word sent down?
On the pupil PDF, colour the mountain and cave (no people) and copy the word اِقْرَأْ under it.
questions.a: A coloured mountain and the word اِقْرَأْ copied
questions.model: Teacher copies اِقْرَأْ slowly: alif, qaf, ra, alif with hamzah.

questions.q: name one way we show respect to the Qur'an.
questions.a: Clean hands, keep it high, read it carefully

questions.q: Back to our ponder: which book is kept safe forever?
